plans.title: Plans
plans.hint: Configure the default plan template used when creating new plans.

vaultSection.title: Team Vault
vaultSection.hint: Share and synchronize Tendril projects, custom skills, MCP servers, and security rules across your team via a versioned Git repository.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: Configure how Tendril notifies you about job completions, failures, and other events.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.restartNote: A Tendril restart is required for changes to take effect.

newsletterSection.title: Newsletter
newsletterSection.hint: Subscribe to the Ivy & Tendril newsletter to receive updates, feature highlights, and release notes.

promptwares.title: Workflow Agents
promptwares.hint: Read each agent's prompt, and configure the coding-agent profile and tool permissions it runs with.
promptwares.notConfigured: Not configured yet. Saving creates the entry.
promptwares.profileHint: Last writer wins: {{key}}, then this agent, then a per-plan or CLI override.
promptwares.allowedHint: Added on top of the base tool set, one rule per line. It never replaces it.
promptwares.deniedHint: Subtracted from the merged allowlist, and unioned with {{key}} rather than narrowing it.

program.title: Prompt
program.hintOverlay: From your overlay directory, which replaces the shipped prompt.
program.hintDeployed: The deployed prompt this agent runs. Read-only: change it from your overlay directory.
program.defaultKey: {{key}} is the fallback applied to every agent rather than an agent of its own, so it has no prompt. Select an agent to read one.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Choose the language Tendril uses. System default follows your operating system.
language.label: Language
language.loadFailed: Could not load {{language}}. Tendril stays in the language it was in.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Choose how Tendril appears. System matches your OS setting.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: Choose a color scheme preset for Tendril.
theme.label: Theme

sidebar.title: Main Sidebar
sidebar.hint: Choose the default state for the main sidebar for new client sessions.
sidebar.saved_expanded: Sidebar set to expanded by default
sidebar.saved_collapsed: Sidebar set to collapsed by default

chatMode.title: Chat
chatMode.hint: Choose how the Chat button talks to your coding agent: the chat view, or the agent's own terminal.

appearance.vaultThemesNote: Themes published by a Team Vault are not listed: the vault theme subsystem is not part of this build, so only the shipped presets are offered.

levels.title: Priority Levels
levels.hint: Define priority levels used to categorize plans.

editor.colorHint: An Ivy colour name, as config.yaml stores it ({{examples}}...).

levels.removeConsequence: Plans already categorised at this level keep the name in their plan.yaml; it simply stops being one of the levels offered.
levels.noEffect: Levels are stored in config.yaml and advertised over MCP, but nothing in this app reads them yet, so editing them here changes no behaviour you can see.

removal.title: Remove {{kind}}
removal.body_reviewAction: Remove review action <name>{{name}}</name> from this configuration?
removal.body_environmentFile: Remove environment file <name>{{name}}</name> from this configuration?
removal.body_mcpServer: Remove MCP server <name>{{name}}</name> from this configuration?
removal.body_customSkill: Remove custom skill <name>{{name}}</name> from this configuration?

explain.label: Explain a setting
explain.prompt: Explain what each top-level key in my config.yaml controls.

addProject.label: Add a project
addProject.prompt: Add a new project to config.yaml and tell me which fields I still have to fill in.

check.label: Check my config
check.prompt: Review my config.yaml for settings that look wrong or are missing a sensible default.

configEditor.maskedNote_one: {{count}} secret value is shown as {{mask}}. Leave a placeholder as it is to keep the stored value; overtype it to set a new one.
configEditor.maskedNote_other: {{count}} secret values are shown as {{mask}}. Leave a placeholder as it is to keep the stored value; overtype it to set a new one.

discard.title: Discard Unsaved Changes
discard.body: Reloading replaces the editor with the file on disk. The edits you have not saved are lost.

security.title: Security & Tunneling
security.hint: Require a password to access Tendril, and expose this instance over a public tunnel.

cloudflared.intro: Both tunnels below run Cloudflare's cloudflared. It is not installed on the machine running Tendril yet.
cloudflared.verifying: Checking the download against Cloudflare's published SHA-256
cloudflared.cancelledBody: The download was cancelled and nothing was installed. You can start it again, or install cloudflared yourself.
cloudflared.manualDownload: Or download {{asset}} from {{url}} and save it as {{path}}.

session.heading: Session Protection
session.blurb: Require a password to access the Tendril interface.

full.heading: Tunnel
full.blurb: Expose your Tendril instance to the internet via a Cloudflare tunnel. Useful for accessing Tendril from mobile devices or sharing with others.
full.activeBody: Your tunnel is running and accessible at the URL below.
full.startingBody: Starting tunnel and waiting for it to become routable. This typically takes 15-30 seconds.

share.heading: Share Tunnel
share.blurb: Expose a read-only, comment-only version of Tendril for team members to review plans and drafts.
share.activeBody: Your share tunnel is running and accessible at the URL below.
share.startingBody: Starting share tunnel and waiting for it to become routable. This typically takes 15-30 seconds.
share.copiedToast: Share tunnel URL copied to clipboard

tunnel.warningBody: A full-access tunnel puts this entire Tendril instance on a public URL. Anyone with the address and the session password can use it as if they were sitting at this machine, so a password is required before one will start. The Share Tunnel below is the read-only option.

errors.status: Could not read the vault status: {{error}}
errors.catalog: Could not read the vault catalog: {{error}}
errors.failure: The vault service reported a failure.

modelCatalog.title: Model Catalog
modelCatalog.hint: Tendril merges the curated model table with a models.dev snapshot cached on disk.
modelCatalog.staticTitle: Catalog is using the static fallback table
modelCatalog.intervalHint: Hours between background refreshes. 0 refreshes once at startup and never again.
modelCatalog.warnAgeHint: Days after which the cache is still used but reported as stale. 0 never warns.
modelCatalog.maxAgeHint: Days after which the cache is ignored and the curated table is used instead. 0 never expires.
